Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
The binding volume commitment is stated immediately after this paragraph; our payment terms are fixed for this agreement. We understand that you are fully booked and that reliable delivery timing and firm commitments matter to you, and we value the planning security a long contract term offers. With our forecast demand for this part rising, could you confirm whether the proposed delivery time is workable for you?

We confirm a binding volume of 23400 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 29.89 (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 29.95 per unit, 23400 units a year, 36 months, lead time 56 days.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your internal cost estimates do not reflect the specialized nature and current realities of our production. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

We acknowledge your volume increase to 23,400 units and the 36-month term, which we are prepared to accept. Based on these parameters and the 56-day lead time, we revise our offer to a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for moving your offer and for recognizing the higher volume and longer contract term; we appreciate both. We can commit to the volume stated below, and the longer term provides planning security while our demand forecast for this part is rising. Payment terms are fixed for this agreement, and our proposal, including all terms, follows below.

We confirm a binding volume of 23400 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Your on-time delivery was 79.5% in 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 31.22 per unit, 23400 units a year, 36 months, lead time 56 days.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
